basic_details.job_title: ACTREC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply by Email
basic_details.short_information: The Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC), Tata Memorial Centre, will hold a walk-in interview on Friday, 20 November 2026, with reporting from 01:30 PM to 01:45 PM at Conference Room No- 66, 1st Floor, Proton Therapy Centre, ACTREC, Sector-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai – 410 210. The interview is for Senior Resident (Anaesthesia) and Senior Resident (Critical Care) in the Department of Anaesthesiology Critical Care and Pain, on consolidated gross pay of Rs.1,33,623/- to Rs.1,45,530/- per month. Indian Nationals who meet the requirements may attend.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 40 years as on Advt date for both posts. The notice allows relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MD/DNB (Anaesthesiology) or equivalent PG degree recognized by NMC
MD/DNB (Anaesthesiology) or (Internal Medicine) or (Emergency Medicine) or (Chest Medicine) recognized by NMC

Bond for those who have completed MCh/DM/DNB/MS/MD from Govt. and Municipal Medical Colleges, Maharashtra, as per GR: MED.1013/NO.101/EDU 2 dated 07.06.2013. Security/caution deposit for Senior Resident is Rs.1,33,623/-. It is paid at the time of joining, or deducted from salary in five equal instalments. The deposit is refunded without interest after completion of SRship/01 Year Fellowship. Residents may resign after completing five months of service by giving one month's notice (6 months' total service) and are then eligible for refund of the deposit. If a Resident leaves without serving the required notice period, the last month's salary (30 days) will be forfeited. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to cancel the posts.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About ACTREC
content_sections.text: ACTREC is part of the Tata Memorial Centre and is located at Sector – 22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. The notice describes it as a Grant-In-Aid Institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The posts are in its Department of Anaesthesiology Critical Care and Pain. The notice is signed by Dr. Bhakti Trivedi, Dean (Health Sciences)-ACTREC, and dated 13 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a separate vacancy count or experience requirement for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full conditions. The age limit is 40 years as on Advt date for both posts. The notice allows relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates. The engagement runs up to 31 July 2027 from the date of joining. Candidates are required to join immediately. Hostel accommodation will be available on campus, subject to availability.

rows.qualification: MD/DNB (Anaesthesiology) or equivalent PG degree recognized by NMC
MD/DNB (Anaesthesiology) or (Internal Medicine) or (Emergency Medicine) or (Chest Medicine) recognized by NMC

rows.per_month: Rs.1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay) - Rs.1,45,530/- p.m. (Gross Pay)

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Recent CV Passport size photograph Original and Xerox copies of educational and work experience certificates Aadhaar Card Candidates must report at the venue within the reporting time only.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates appear at the venue between 01:30 PM and 01:45 PM with the documents above. The notice says Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for MCQ/Interview, and that merely fulfilling the prescribed qualifications will not entitle an applicant to be called for MCQ/Interview. It also reserves the right to fix minimum eligibility standards and cut-off marks (Group/Stream/Discipline/Category-wise etc.) both for calling candidates to the interview and for final selection after it. The decision of the Director, Tata Memorial Centre is final.

content_sections.heading: Online Interview Option
content_sections.text: Indian Nationals who cannot attend the walk-in may register for an online interview. They must send their CV, educational and work experience certificates and Aadhaar card as soft copies in pdf format to [email protected] by 18 November 2026 till 05:00 PM. The subject of the email should be "Application for the post of "Name of the post"". Only shortlisted candidates will get a link for the online interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Senior Resident at ACTREC is considered as part of the P.G. Bond for those who have completed MCh/DM/DNB/MS/MD from Govt. and Municipal Medical Colleges, Maharashtra, as per GR: MED.1013/NO.101/EDU 2 dated 07.06.2013. Security/caution deposit for Senior Resident is Rs.1,33,623/-. It is paid at the time of joining, or deducted from salary in five equal instalments. The deposit is refunded without interest after completion of SRship/01 Year Fellowship. Residents may resign after completing five months of service by giving one month's notice (6 months' total service) and are then eligible for refund of the deposit. If a Resident leaves without serving the required notice period, the last month's salary (30 days) will be forfeited. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to cancel the posts.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ACTREC Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on Friday, 20 November 2026. Candidates must report between 01:30 PM and 01:45 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the ACTREC walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at Conference Room No- 66, 1st Floor, Proton Therapy Centre, ACTREC, Sector-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai – 410 210.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Senior Resident (Anaesthesia)?
faq.answer: The qualification is MD/DNB (Anaesthesiology) or equivalent PG degree recognized by NMC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Senior Resident (Critical Care)?
faq.answer: The qualification is MD/DNB (Anaesthesiology) or (Internal Medicine) or (Emergency Medicine) or (Chest Medicine) recognized by NMC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ACTREC Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years as on Advt date, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an ACTREC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: MD/DNB holders get Rs.1,33,623/- to Rs.1,45,530/- p.m. (Gross Pay), subject to experience. DM/DrNB holders get Rs.1,45,530/- p.m. (Gross Pay).

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the ACTREC walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring a recent CV, passport size photograph, original and Xerox copies of educational and work experience certificates, and your Aadhaar Card.

faq.question: Q8. Can I attend the ACTREC interview online?
faq.answer: Indian Nationals unable to attend may email their CV, certificates and Aadhaar card in pdf format to [email protected] by 18 November 2026 till 05:00 PM. Only shortlisted candidates get an online interview link.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the ACTREC Senior Resident appointment?
faq.answer: The engagement is up to 31 July 2027 from the date of joining, and candidates are required to join immediately.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a security deposit for ACTREC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Yes, the security/caution deposit is Rs.1,33,623/-, paid at joining or deducted in five equal instalments from salary. It is refunded without interest after completion of SRship/01 Year Fellowship.
